summary: Hertz Global Holdings priced a registered offering of 37,037,037 common shares at $2.70 per share, loaned to J.P. Morgan Securities under a share lending agreement. Proceeds support note-hedging via short sales or derivatives. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor named. Structure involves a share loan to facilitate convertible note hedging. Watch SEC review and market absorption of the short position; no risk-arb angle as it is not a merger.
